rows.label: bf04300100_0020
rows.name:
Production has been running at full capacity
for 24 hours, mo.

rows.label: bf04300100_0035
rows.name:
We'll sell the first 1000 ether
furnaces produced to Iira, mo.

rows.label: bf04300100_0040
rows.name:
Huh? But the funding here comes from
Senator Roderich of the Empire, mo.

rows.label: bf04300100_0050
rows.name:
Didn't the Senator also provide the information
on the Core Chips Kiku stole as materials?

rows.label: bf04300100_0060
rows.name:
That doesn't matter, mo. Whoever
pays more gets priority.

rows.label: bf04300100_0070
rows.name: That old man can wait a while, mo.

rows.label: bf04300100_0080
rows.name:
Once war with Invidia starts, he'll panic
and pay even more, mo.

rows.label: bf04300100_0090
rows.name:
As expected of Chairman Bahn. To think you've
thought this far ahead... I'm impressed, mo.

rows.label: bf04300100_0100
rows.name: Fumomo. That's the basics of making money, mo.
